caption: Figure 4.5 Diagrammatic representation of a test cross
labels: Half of the flowers are violet and half of the flowers are white.
note: Labels listed top-left to bottom-right. Multi-line labels are joined with a single space ('Homozygous recessive', 'Dominant Phenotype (Genotype unknown)', 'Half of the flowers are violet and half of the flowers are white.', 'Unknown flower is homozygous dominant'). Genotype pairs are printed with a visible gap between the two letters ('W w'); they are transcribed closed up as 'Ww' / 'ww'. Reading of the two Punnett squares, verified at high magnification: left square all four cells 'Ww'; right square top row 'Ww', 'Ww' and bottom row 'ww', 'ww'. The gamete circles are w, w above each square; W (upper) and W (lower) at the left square, W (upper) and w (lower) at the right square. 'WW' and 'Ww' on the central arrows are the two alternative genotypes of the unknown dominant parent, and '?' is printed above its flower. Over-included and excluded: the running head 'PRINCIPLES OF INHERITANCE AND VARIATION' at the top, the leaf motif at the top right, and two partial body lines below the caption ('Based on his observations on monohybrid crosses Mendel proposed' and a second line cut by the bottom crop edge). Figure and caption themselves are complete and unclipped.
